findings.evidence: "Open the alerts panel from the console sidebar and select the rule you want to adjust."
findings.fix: Add directional language such as "Click the Alerts icon in the left sidebar, or navigate to Administration > Alerts to open the alerts panel."
findings.violation: The instruction assumes users can locate the alerts panel without guidance on where to find it or what it looks like.

findings.evidence: "confirm the unit matches the metric in use"
findings.fix: Replace with "confirm that the unit of measurement (such as milliseconds, bytes, or percentage) matches the metric being configured."
findings.location: Section "Set the new threshold", second sentence
findings.violation: The phrase "unit" is undefined and the reader does not know what units are relevant or how to check them.

findings.evidence: "This is because the console applies the new threshold to every future evaluation of this rule."
findings.fix: Delete this sentence or reword to explain consequences, such as "Mismatched units will cause the threshold to trigger at unexpected values."
findings.location: Section "Set the new threshold", last sentence
findings.violation: This sentence repeats the obvious function of the threshold rather than explaining why unit confirmation matters.

findings.evidence: "Save the rule and open the rule list to confirm the new threshold appears there."
findings.fix: Replace with "Click Save. Navigate to the Alerts page and verify that your rule displays the updated threshold value in the list."
findings.violation: "Rule list" is undefined and the reader does not know what to look for when they open it.

findings.evidence: The document uses three H2 headings (Open alert settings, Set the new threshold, Save and verify) with no introduction explaining the overall process.
findings.fix: Add an introductory paragraph after the H1 heading explaining that this guide covers three steps to update an alert threshold.
findings.violation: Readers do not see a summary of the workflow before diving into individual steps.
